system.description:
You bite your finger drawing blood before using it as a catalyst to summon Rashomon, 60 feet tall, 30 Feet wide, and 5 feet thick gate made of iron, brick, chakra and other materials. This wall is erected standing straight upward. If you are in an area that cannot fit Rashomon, this jutsu will fail.

When summoned, Rashomon intercepts all damage you or an allied creature in range would take. Rashomon has 100 Hit points and is resistant to all damage. Rashomon has 25 AC and remains where it was summoned for 1 minute or its hit points are reduced to 0.

If Rashomon’s Hit points are reduced to 0 it disappears and cannot be summoned again until you complete a long rest.
